about: Half the change: the queue is served -- the first waiting hold ready with the copy and a week to collect it, a notice sent, the copy marked held -- and anyone may still borrow the held copy, and nobody's hold is ever collected. Its own test covers the queue only.

mutations.find: a copy and its status: `shelf` or `loan`
mutations.replace: a copy and its status: `shelf`, `loan` or `held`

mutations.find: - `src/holds.mjs` — holds: members waiting for a title.
mutations.replace: - `src/holds.mjs` — holds: members waiting for a title, first come, first served.

mutations.find: // copy may stay out -- three weeks for a book, one week for a DVD -- and a copy is on the shelf or on loan.
mutations.replace:
// copy may stay out -- three weeks for a book, one week for a DVD -- and a copy is on the shelf, on loan, or held for a

mutations.find: // A loan brought back on a day: fined for the days it is late and the fine charged to its member, and its copy shelved.
mutations.replace:
// A loan brought back on a day: fined for the days it is late and the fine charged to its member, and its copy set
// aside for the member who has waited longest for the title -- or shelved.

mutations.find: // (dropbox.mjs). A late return is fined and the fine charged to the member, and the copy goes back on the shelf.
mutations.replace:
// (dropbox.mjs). A late return is fined and the fine charged to the member; the copy then goes to whoever is waiting
// for its title, or back on the shelf.

mutations.find: // Whether anybody is waiting for a copy's title.
mutations.replace: // Whether anybody is waiting for a copy's title: a hold placed and not yet served.
